measure: PageRank determinism. Synthetic: SyntheticGraphs.generate(n, n / 75, 30) for n = 3000, 30000, 100000; StructuralGraphAnalysis.compute over the generation order and over five shuffled arrival orders of the same types and rows, every double compared as raw bits; the control builds JGraphT directly, sorted and unsorted (PageRankTest's control seed), and runs PageRank with the production constants. Tolerance: on the 30000-type synthetic graph and on Elasticsearch ALL, both orientations, the iterations JGraphT needs at 1e-6 and 1e-10 by bisecting the cap with the two-run recipe (PR(cap) bitwise equal to PR(cap+1)), and the error against a reference vector at 1e-15 (cap 2000). Corpus: five repositories x two selections, two analyses each through the real AnalysisRegistry with the production plan plus the STRUCTURAL_GRAPH stage, on fresh data directories; graph_metric and package_edge dumped by element_id with doubles as raw bits, compared byte for byte; sums, top ten and one-top-level-type cycles are SQL over the persisted rows. Elasticsearch ALL's second analysis also feeds the input it read back from the cache to compute in five shuffled orders.

synthetic.generator: SyntheticGraphs.generate(types, types / 75, 30): PageRankTest's generator: log-normal out-degree (sigma 0.9, mean 6), 15% of types depend on no internal type, 30% are never a target, Zipf(1) targets over a permutation; each pair becomes 1-3 rows of distinct DependencyTypes, half the types get one external row and one in twenty a self row

tolerance.iterations: two-run recipe at the given tolerance; the smallest converged cap in [1, PAGERANK_MAX_ITER] by bisection
tolerance.percentiles: mid-rank percentile of each vertex within its own vector, Math.round(10 x pct) compared against the reference's

decision.rule: PASS iff two builds of the graph from the same rows in different arrival orders produce bit-identical doubles (five shuffled orders of every synthetic graph and of Elasticsearch ALL; two analyses of every corpus selection) and |sum - 1| <= 1e-9 for every PageRank vector of every graph, each containing dangling nodes in G and in G_rev; else FAIL
